[EN] The baraka are interested in all sorts of things...I've never seen a book like this before.
[ES] Los baraka se interesan por todo tipo de cosas... Nunca antes había visto un libro así.

[EN] It's infamous! A cursed book.
[ES] ¡Es infame! Un libro maldito.

[EN] It's supposed to bring bad luck to its bearer.
[ES] Se supone que trae mala suerte a quien lo porta.

[EN] Still, I heard they printed thousands of copies, years ago.
[ES] Aun así, escuché que imprimieron miles de copias hace años.

[EN] Rumor has it that the book is made from popori skin...
[ES] Corre el rumor de que el libro está hecho de piel de popori...
